# Evidence instructions

- Copy [`docs/evidence/templates/evidence-record.template.md`](../../docs/evidence/templates/evidence-record.template.md)
  for new records.
- Classify brief evidence as exactly one of `measured`, `modeled`, `assumed`,
  or `gap`; never blur the distinction in the "Results" section.
- Include the "Limitations" section honestly, even when it feels like an
  admission of weakness — an unstated limitation is worse than a stated
  one.
- Do not create an evidence record until real results, a real model, or a
  clearly stated assumption exists to record. Do not write one to make a
  claim elsewhere look more validated than it is.
- No tenant/subscription IDs, customer names, internal hostnames, or
  unsupported performance claims.
- Add a line to the index in `docs/evidence/README.md` for every new
  record.
